description: §6.7.4 rule 4: a call through a binding the compiler cannot resolve to a known set of scrml functions fails closed — E-EFFECT-WRITE-UNPROVEN.
rationale: §6.7.4 rule 4: "**Code whose writes the compiler cannot determine fails closed, as E-EFFECT-WRITE-UNPROVEN:** … a call through a function-typed binding the compiler cannot resolve to a known set of scrml functions". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S447 "`when` → outside-world effects only, spelled `<effect>`" — "your recs, except expound 3b, specifically why the engine restriction."
